notes.title: Experimental Update 1
notes.content: [p]Hi! I've decided to push out the first experimental update on the [b]Experimental Branch[/b].[/p][p]If you would like to try it out, you can do so in the [b]Betas[/b] tab of the properties page of Cargo.[/p][p][/p][h2]This update is now available on the default branch[/h2][p][/p][h2]VERY IMPORTANT[/h2][p]TO PLAY THIS UPDATE, YOU MUST DELETE YOUR SAVE FILE. THIS CAN BE FOUND IN C:\\Users\\<your name>\\Documents\\Cargo\\Saves. IF YOU DO NOT DELETE YOUR SAVE, THE GAME WILL NOT FUNCTION (This is not intentional)[/p][p][/p][h1]Changes[/h1][list][*][p]Added animations to the player model, including grabbing and dropping. (I WAS SO EXCITED FOR HOW IT TURNED OUT SO ENJOY!!!)[/p][/*][*][p]Added day/night cycle along with custom skybox[/p][/*][*][p]Added more shop items (Speed Shoes, Stamina Soda)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a map (Open with M), this should make it easier to find Customer locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Minimap in favor of the map[/p][/*][*][p]Added Customer icon to map (When you collect a package or grab one from your backpack, it will create a blue icon on the map above the location you must deliver to)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a crosshair (So it is easier to look at and collect packages that are dropped)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added new save data terms (Player Location, Current Package (Package in your hand), Backpack Packages)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Reporting Bugs[/h2][p]If you wish to report a bug to me, join the Discord by clicking the button below and fill out a report in #bugs.[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/EkPG5Pc892" style="button"]Click to join[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Official Cargo OST[/h2][p]The Cargo OST Album is out now on Spotify, Apple Music, iTunes, and any other mainstream provider! You can check it out on Spotify by clicking the link below.[/p][p][url="https://open.spotify.com/album/2S3Uc5eAaFzjCGbTgnv0UW?si=WMOdTWdjQi-53r2QeCl8Bg"]https://open.spotify.com/album/2S3Uc5eAaFzjCGbTgnv0UW?si=WMOdTWdjQi-53r2QeCl8Bg[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I've had so much fun working on Cargo, even though we've had some tough times. I can't wait for the adventures we have together in the future. [b]Have fun and happy gaming!![/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Progress & Status
notes.content:
Hi! I'd like to say that development for Cargo is back underway. VERY slowly though, while I recuperate from the events of the past month. Anywayyyyy,

[h1][b]Progress Tracking[/b][/h1]
I have recreated the Trello board for progress on Cargo. If you would like to view it, click [url=https://trello.com/b/sMTnXEBw/cargo]here.[/url]

[h1][b]Suggestions[/b][/h1]
If you would like to suggest a feature that isn't already in the game or on Trello, fill out the form by clicking [url=https://forms.gle/toCx6YnSaEP91jDc8]here.[/url]

[h1][b]Finally[/b][/h1]
Thank you to everyone who has actually been supporting my game and its development. Thank you for believing in me when I didn't even believe in myself. I know there have been some speed bumps, but we're back on the road. For the foreseeable future, [b]no one outside of my IRL friends or family will be joining development.[/b] I have learned a tough lesson. I will also not be relisting the Steam page until June 25th (It could take longer cause Steam takes forever to reply to support tickets ykyk).

If you would like to chat with me or talk to other Cargo players, join the Discord!

notes.title: Our Progress (and when the next update is released)
notes.content:
I'd like to take a minute to talk about our progress in the game and make some announcements.

[h1]The Future of Killswitch Games[/h1]
As you may know from my last post for the 2.0A update, I am a solo developer for Killswitch (my company). Not anymore, [b][i]technically[/i][/b]. I have started working with one of my closest IRL friends on map design and the [b]story[/b] for Cargo. She is working under Killswitch Games but she is not working for me. I'd also like to announce that Killswitch Games is currently in the process of being renamed to Floppy Fish Studios. I'd like to focus on creating silly goofy fun games for everyone to play. And I think that the name Killswitch is too... Violent? Especially for the type of games I work on.

[h1]When should you expect Cargo to be released?[/h1]
I plan to release Cargo sometime during the summer this year at the earliest, this could extend into fall but it is unlikely. After the release, we will definitely keep making updates. This is my first ever game, so I plan to put everything into it. 

[h1]Our Next Project[/h1]
For our next project, [b]Silly Cat Game[/b]. Which is pretty self explanatory. I have worked on it a little bit during my downtime working on Cargo. But i'm not going to fully commit to it till after I fully publish Cargo. Also, SCG will be created in Godot which should help with lag and such stuff. I will have to figure out how to integrate it onto Steam but once I work on it and get a first release for it, it will be on itch.io for free.

[h1]Contact & Recommendations[/h1]
If you have any questions about Cargo and want to recommend some features or game ideas to us, shoot me a message on Discord (scythepng) or [url=https://discord.gg/tRFfMsPqEg]join our Discord[/url].

I love making this game and I hope I can release it soon. I want you guys to have fun while playing this.

notes.title: V2.0A IS HERE!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that V2.0Alpha is finally out! As you may have seen from the thumbnail, we have added ALOT. For beginners:

[h1]Missions[/h1]
The main element to Cargo. Will, the missions NPC allows you to accept or decline missions to collect.

[h1]The Grid System[/h1]
Allows you to easily locate packages. Since we used Facepunch.Steamworks for Steam integration, we thought it would be fitting to use a similar grid system to Facepunch's own game, Rust.

[h1]The Shop[/h1]
The shop allows you to buy fuel, wood, or power-ups such as:
[list]
[*] Quickfeet (Allows you to sprint)
[*] Longlegs (Doubles your movement speed and sprint speed if Quickfeet is unlocked)
[/list]

We are hoping to add alot more as time passes. I say we like I own a studio, so I have some kinda bad news. I am a solo dev. I am also a sophmore in high school, so I don't get alot of sleep or I sleep during the day which results in me not getting any dev work done. I try to when I can but i'm hopeful that I can get the game ready for release in May at the earliest.

I can't wait to add more elements to this game for everyone and to finally release it. Enjoy the Alpha phase!

[b]One more thing[/b]
I have decided to remove mutliplayer from the game indefinitly, or atleast until I can get a good standing on the game.
